question: What widespread honor did the maiden receive after the slaying of Kola?
premises: She was worshipped by all the worlds.
The worship occurred in house after house.
inference: That maiden was worshipped by all the worlds in every house.
uncertainties: The tokenization splits asarva and lokaiḥ; together they express sarva-lokaiḥ, 'by all worlds'.
plain_english: And that maiden was worshipped by all the worlds, in house after house.
